mapper.select: SELECT cr.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, cr.MEMBER_CODE, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME, cr.PROFILE_IMAGE AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN TRIM(cr.ACTIVITY_NAME) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cr.CREATOR_INTRODUCTION) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cr.ACTIVITY_REGION) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PROFILE_COMPLETE FROM CREATOR cr WHERE cr.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE CREATOR SET APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' WHERE MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '대기' AND TRIM(ACTIVITY_NAME) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CREATOR_INTRODUCTION) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ACTIVITY_REGION) IS NOT NULL
